data.body: PARALLEL RE-PLANNING WAVE: ran plan-review on all 5 ready stories concurrently — ALL BLOCKED (systematic under-specification of consumer census/mechanisms in the brainstormed plans). S3(type): stamp-site + all EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES consumers + 3rd _EXCLUDED_PREFIXES copy (inbound_collection_diffs.py:88). S4(link): emission is outbound_links.py::_diff_links not outbound_differ; 2 backends (jira/backend.py:323, dc/backend.py:527); tuple-valued RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK vs Mapping[str,str] axis; link_types vocab. S5(priority): int-keyed built-in vs str config; census Cloud+DC create + UPDATE mapper; drop priority fail-closed (drift+warn only). S8(probe): 'bridge probe' is a RETIRED alias for check-access → rename verb; specify TOML serialization. S6(replay): reviewer couldn't ground the 'recorded status-hop sequence' — must find event-sourced status history + real transport methods, else redesign. Dispatched 5 background general-purpose agents (one per story) to do the code census + produce remediated plan drafts in /tmp/s{3,4,5,6,8}_replan.md. f1bc landed+closed earlier this session.
